name: fusion_360_rectangular_prism_sample
description: A source-derived single rectangular prism converted from a Fusion 360 Gallery regraph face-extrusion sequence.
derived_by: Derived from Fusion 360 Gallery Reconstruction Dataset construction sequence after conversion to Prompt2ParametricCAD JSON.
construction_plan: Read the Fusion 360 regraph sequence and find the single NewBody extrude.
Use the start and end face centroids to infer the extrusion axis.
Use the source bounding box for the rectangular sketch dimensions and extrusion distance.
Convert Fusion 360 Gallery centimeters to Prompt2ParametricCAD millimeters.
notes: This is a conservative bounding-box conversion from regraph data, not a full raw Fusion timeline conversion.
Converted dimensions: 39.0 mm by 68.0 mm by 10.0 mm.
